correctness.rationale: The claim is finite and exhaustively checked over all 65535 nonempty subsets. Spectrality is reduced exactly to pairwise Fourier-zero differences, with Fourier zeros decided by integer equalities n0=n2 and n1=n3. Tiling is reduced exactly to a difference-set disjointness criterion. The two independent predicates agree subset by subset. The affine classification separately enumerates all 192 automorphisms, all 3072 affine maps, and every accepted orbit.
